verdict.rationale: Docs claim Claude Code maps codebases for root-cause analysis, debugs live apps via Chrome, runs tests, and 'verifies it works' as part of its workflow (docs-2, docs-15, docs-17, docs-8, docs-16). However, community reports directly contradict the self-verification claim, describing unreliable fixes (e.g., replace_all corrupting constants) and stating 'You absolutely can't trust it to self-verify,' with one user reporting a 100% failure rate over a month.
